thread:
Alex: Heads up — Grand Sock Summit tomorrow 3pm in the kitchen. Bring your weirdest socks. Prize: Golden Laundry Badge :trophy: 
Maria: Wait are we actually doing a sock pageant or a relay race? :thinking: 
Jamal: Both. Also there will be a very serious panel to judge Pattern Integrity. 
Sophia: I already have a candidate — one sock with a tiny taco on it. It sings when you fold it. (jk) :laughing: 
Tina: Putting this in my calendar. Can someone remind ops-bot to play the ceremonial anthem? :notes: @ops-bot please? 
ops-bot: Reminder set for 14:50 tomorrow with playlist "Laundry Anthems". :robot_face: 
Maria: Is there a dress code? Asking for a friend who only owns black socks. 
Alex: Mismatched encouraged. Bonus points for narrative (e.g., "fallen from the cargo ship of 2016"). 
Jamal: Can we have a side category for "Most Likely To Hide In A Backpack"? :backpack: 
Sophia: I'll bring a ballot box (aka cereal tin) and those little numbered stickers. Old school. 
Tina: Photo evidence mandatory. If your sock has a backstory, you must present it dramatically. 
Maria: Voting rules? One vote per person, secret ballot, judge's tiebreaker by interpretive dance. 
Alex: Official rules: 1) Bring socks 2) Short backstory 3) One vote each 4) Winners get the Golden Laundry Badge + leftover cupcakes. 
Jamal: If anyone needs to pre-register a sock, drop a pic here and I'll add it to the unofficial catalog. 
Sophia: Pre-registering Taco Sock. Photo: <https://files.redwood.internal/socks/taco-sock.jpg> :sweat_smile: 
Maria: Signed up: Mystery Polka, Office Heater Sock, Lost Conference Sock #7. 
Tina: I'll jury-rig a tiny podium out of a Post-it stack. 
Alex: Epic. See you all tomorrow. Any last-minute sock pickups? 
ops-bot: Posting directions to the kitchen in #help for any newcomers. :robot_face: 
Jamal: Also leaving a tiny flag in the stapler drawer for the champion. This is official lore now. :sparkles:
